topic: Tenses – Various exercises: Negation of sentences
title: Making Sentences Negative: All Tenses

explanation.tr:
Bir cümleyi olumsuz yapmanın genel kuralı: yardımcı fiilden sonra 'not' ekle.
• Yardımcı fiil varsa (be, have, will, can, must…): ona not ekle → is not / has not / will not / can not
• Yardımcı fiil yoksa (Simple Present/Past): do/does/did ekle → don't / doesn't / didn't + yalın fiil
Belirsiz kelimeleri değiştir:
• some → any: I have some money. → I don't have any money.
• already → yet: She has already left. → She hasn't left yet.
• somebody → anybody / nobody; always → never (or not always)
explanation.tk:
Sözlemi ýokluk görnüşe öwürmegiň umumy düzgüni: kömekçi işlikden soň 'not' goş.
• Kömekçi işlik bar bolsa (be, have, will, can, must…): oňa not goş → is not / has not / will not / can not
• Kömekçi işlik ýok bolsa (Simple Present/Past): do/does/did goş → don't / doesn't / didn't + esasy işlik
Näbelli sözleri üýtget:
• some → any: I have some money. → I don't have any money.
• already → yet: She has already left. → She hasn't left yet.
• somebody → anybody / nobody; always → never (ýa-da not always)
explanation.ru:
Общее правило отрицания: добавь 'not' после вспомогательного глагола.
• Если есть вспомогательный (be, have, will, can, must…): добавь к нему not → is not / has not / will not / can not
• Если его нет (Simple Present/Past): добавь do/does/did → don't / doesn't / didn't + начальная форма
Замени неопределённые слова:
• some → any: I have some money. → I don't have any money.
• already → yet: She has already left. → She hasn't left yet.
• somebody → anybody / nobody; always → never (или not always)

examples.en: I have some money. → I don't have any money.
She has already left. → She hasn't left yet.
Somebody called. → Nobody called.
We must hurry. → We mustn't hurry. / We don't have to hurry.

examples.ru: Нам нельзя спешить. / Нам не нужно спешить.

examples.en: He always helps. → He never helps.

topic: Tenses – Various exercises: Present time phrases or past time phrases
title: Present or Past Time Phrases?

explanation.tr:
Zaman ifadeleri hangi zamanı kullanacağını söyler:
• Present (şimdiki/genel): now, today, at the moment, these days, nowadays, every day, usually, always, this week
• Past (geçmiş): yesterday, last night/week/year, … ago, in 2010, the day before yesterday, then, when I was young
• Dikkat: 'this morning' saat hâlâ sabahsa present, öğleden sonraysa past olabilir.
  I'm working this morning. (şu an sabah) / I worked hard this morning. (sabah bitti)
explanation.tk:
Wagt aňlatmalary haýsy zamany ulanmalydygyny aýdýar:
• Present (häzirki/umumy): now, today, at the moment, these days, nowadays, every day, usually, always, this week
• Past (geçmiş): yesterday, last night/week/year, … ago, in 2010, the day before yesterday, then, when I was young
• Üns beriň: 'this morning' häzir henizem ir bolsa present, günortandan soň bolsa past bolup biler.
  I'm working this morning. (häzir ir) / I worked hard this morning. (ir geçdi)
explanation.ru:
Выражения времени подсказывают время глагола:
• Present (настоящее/обычное): now, today, at the moment, these days, nowadays, every day, usually, always, this week
• Past (прошлое): yesterday, last night/week/year, … ago, in 2010, the day before yesterday, then, when I was young
• Внимание: 'this morning' — если утро ещё не прошло, present; если уже день — past.
  I'm working this morning. (сейчас утро) / I worked hard this morning. (утро прошло)

topic: Tenses – Various exercises: Questions and short answers in English
title: Short Answers in All Tenses

explanation.tr:
Kısa cevaplarda sorudaki yardımcı fiil tekrarlanır:
• Do you…? → Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
• Does she…? → Yes, she does. / No, she doesn't.
• Did they…? → Yes, they did. / No, they didn't.
• Are you…? → Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
• Was he…? → Yes, he was. / No, he wasn't.
• Have you…? → Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.
• Will it…? → Yes, it will. / No, it won't.
• Can you…? → Yes, I can. / No, I can't.
Olumlu kısa cevapta kısaltma yok: Yes, I am. (Yes, I'm ✗)
explanation.tk:
Gysga jogaplarda soragdaky kömekçi işlik gaýtalanýar:
• Do you…? → Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
• Does she…? → Yes, she does. / No, she doesn't.
• Did they…? → Yes, they did. / No, they didn't.
• Are you…? → Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
• Was he…? → Yes, he was. / No, he wasn't.
• Have you…? → Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.
• Will it…? → Yes, it will. / No, it won't.
• Can you…? → Yes, I can. / No, I can't.
Tassyklaýjy gysga jogapda gysgaltma ýok: Yes, I am. (Yes, I'm ✗)
explanation.ru:
В кратких ответах повторяется вспомогательный глагол из вопроса:
• Do you…? → Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
• Does she…? → Yes, she does. / No, she doesn't.
• Did they…? → Yes, they did. / No, they didn't.
• Are you…? → Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
• Was he…? → Yes, he was. / No, he wasn't.
• Have you…? → Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.
• Will it…? → Yes, it will. / No, it won't.
• Can you…? → Yes, I can. / No, I can't.
В утвердительном кратком ответе без сокращения: Yes, I am. (Yes, I'm ✗)

examples.en: Do you like tea? – Yes, I do.
Did she call? – No, she didn't.
Are they ready? – Yes, they are.
Have you eaten? – No, I haven't.
Will it be cold? – Yes, it will.
Can you swim? – No, I can't.

topic: Tenses – Various exercises: Signal words – Tenses
title: Signal Words for Every Tense

explanation.tr:
Sinyal kelimeler tablosu:
• Simple Present: always, usually, often, sometimes, never, every…, on Mondays
• Present Progressive: now, right now, at the moment, Look!, Listen!, today, this week
• Simple Past: yesterday, last…, … ago, in 2010, when I was…
• Past Progressive: while, at 8 pm yesterday, all day yesterday
• Present Perfect: just, already, yet, ever, never, since, for, so far, recently
• Past Perfect: before, after, by the time, already (geçmişte)
• will-future: tomorrow, next…, I think, probably, soon
• going to: Look! (+ işaret), planlar
explanation.tk:
Alamat sözleriň tablisasy:
• Simple Present: always, usually, often, sometimes, never, every…, on Mondays
• Present Progressive: now, right now, at the moment, Look!, Listen!, today, this week
• Simple Past: yesterday, last…, … ago, in 2010, when I was…
• Past Progressive: while, at 8 pm yesterday, all day yesterday
• Present Perfect: just, already, yet, ever, never, since, for, so far, recently
• Past Perfect: before, after, by the time, already (geçmişde)
• will-future: tomorrow, next…, I think, probably, soon
• going to: Look! (+ alamat), meýilnamalar
explanation.ru:
Таблица слов-маркеров:
• Simple Present: always, usually, often, sometimes, never, every…, on Mondays
• Present Progressive: now, right now, at the moment, Look!, Listen!, today, this week
• Simple Past: yesterday, last…, … ago, in 2010, when I was…
• Past Progressive: while, at 8 pm yesterday, all day yesterday
• Present Perfect: just, already, yet, ever, never, since, for, so far, recently
• Past Perfect: before, after, by the time, already (в прошлом)
• will-future: tomorrow, next…, I think, probably, soon
• going to: Look! (+ признак), планы
